description: Creates an app; returns appId and url. One source at most: `decisions` (starter code and config; incomplete decisions create nothing), `example` (copy of an example app, without its users or purchases) or `template`; none gives an empty app with no files. With an index.html it is live for users at once; an empty app is not, until an index.html is uploaded and promoted. The same call repeated returns the same app. Backend for a site hosted elsewhere: create one, then neblla_update_app addDomain. Copying settings between apps: neblla_copy_app_config. More: neblla_get_llms tools/create_app

acceptDpa.description: true only once the developer has accepted Neblla's terms and DPA; needed for their first app (else error dpa_required).

decisions.description: The complete `decisions` from neblla_validate_requirements, as it returned them.

example.description: A catalog example to copy: yoga, puzzle, templates, quiz, padel, cards, tag or obby.

lang.description: With `example`: the copy's language (en, es, fr, de, it, pt, ja, ko, zh, ar); left out, the developer's.

name.description: Display name; required unless `example` is given.

template.description: Legacy, instead of `decisions`: rooms, lobby-only, solo-save or home.

name: neblla_create_app
title: Create an app
